text: Content objects for now. beat_hesitate.json deliberately never names fear ('Korkuyorum' becomes the label the child carries out of the book) and EmotionalArc keeps fear/panic out of the band. One book cannot outweigh that editorial decision, and bedtime must never peak on fear. If revisited, it needs privacy-safety plus more works, and a learning-mode framing (a named feeling met by a supporting adult), not adventure peaks.
